title: Choose the look for tilaOK
question: The roll picked the Egg Tray direction. Keep it, take the Kalendaryo pick or the plain standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Egg Tray
options.lineage: 30-cup molded-pulp egg trays and their ink grade stamps
options.thesis: The flock's last 30 seconds sit in a 30-cup egg tray; each cup is one prediction.
options.viewport: Top bar with mic picker and Start. Left: a huge stamped status word (tilaOK / CHECK FLOCK). Right: the 6x5 tray filling cup by cup, with the last 5 cups ringed as the alert window. Below: three confidence bars and the event log.
options.risk: Pulp grey can turn dull if the stamp inks are applied timidly.

raised.raise: One type family at every scale, with the status word set at poster size.
Flat, unmodulated colour fields, with no fake pulp texture or grain.
Nothing disappears, it gets stamped: alerts and the session report are stamped onto the record.
Length means exact duration: the session timeline bar is drawn to true time.
Tabular figures at data density for every number and timestamp.
Each class keeps fixed furniture: same name plate, colour and position everywhere.

options.label: Kalendaryo
options.lineage: the feed-store wall calendar hanging in every farm house
options.thesis: The session reads like a calendar page: big numerals, red marks on the bad moments.
options.viewport: Top bar with controls. A big numeral block (alerts this hour) beside the status. Session minutes laid out as a calendar grid, with red marks on alert minutes.
options.risk: A familiar print grid. Many Filipino-themed pages reach for it.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.case: Farmers don't recognise it, and pixel type hurts glanceable reading.
options.kept: One face repeated at many sizes.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.case: Playful, but it hides the alert state.
options.risk: Too whimsical for a health alert.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: Each class as a mascot with a name plate.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: The session as a stamped coupon.
options.case: The report idea is clear, but farmers don't identify with airline coupons.

options.label: Dance Score
options.thesis: Time flows up a centre staff.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Barcode bars strobing in black and white.
options.case: Cold and strobing, and it has no healthy/unhealthy language.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean farm IoT dashboard: white cards, green accent, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Header, a status card, confidence bars, a log card and a summary card in a tidy grid.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other IoT demo.
